Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the task and relied on current availability listings (e.g., Amazon Prime Video via aggregators) instead of identifying the original streaming service that adapted and premiered the series. Despite visible evidence on the results page stating the show “premiered on Crackle,” WebSurfer concluded Amazon Prime Video, leading away from the correct answer (Crackle).
